scene.label: Interactive 3D lesson network showing SBD-DC01 and SBD-DC02 on VLAN 10, the two domain controllers that replicate the sbd.test directory to each other and serve the directory, DNS and domain time to the rest of the network through the core.
scene.completeCaption: SBD-DC01 and SBD-DC02 both hold the sbd.test directory and DNS on their own VLAN 10 segment, replicate in both directions, and pass DCDiag. SBD-DC01 holds the operations master roles and, as PDC emulator, is the network's time source. Every later course builds on this foundation.

nodes.name: SBD-DC01
nodes.title: SBD-DC01 · 10.0.10.10
nodes.description: The first domain controller, promoted in chapter 2 to create the sbd.test forest. It holds the directory, DNS and the five operations master roles; as PDC emulator it is the time source for the whole network. Its default gateway is the core's VLAN 10 address, 10.0.10.1.

nodes.name: SBD-DC02
nodes.title: SBD-DC02 · 10.0.10.11
nodes.description: The second writable domain controller, added in chapter 3 so the directory has two service points. It holds its own copy of the directory and DNS, replicates with SBD-DC01 in both directions, and keeps the domain available while either controller is down.

flows.label: Directory, DNS and domain time served to the network
A second service point for the segment

chapters.network: DC01 and DC02 are planned on VLAN 10, their own segment behind the core. Nothing is promoted yet; each server has its final name and static address.
SBD-DC01 is promoted and creates the sbd.test forest. It serves the directory, DNS and domain time to the network through the core; SBD-DC02 is still a planned system.
Both controllers serve the domain. The moving connection between them follows directory replication, and SBD-DC02 answers through the core as well.
DCDiag runs against each controller and replication is confirmed in both directions. Select either controller to read its part in the checks.
The directory has two service points and a build record that connects each configuration choice with dated evidence. Later courses add the systems that depend on it.
